in_arabic.name: Fahadah
in_arabic.meaning: اسم عربي يعني Given by God
in_arabic.long_meaning: Fahadah هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic root 'fahada' which means 'to give'. In Islam, this name symbolizes the belief that everything comes from God and that He is the giver of all blessings.
